An '''exterminator backpack''' was a type of [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]]<ref name="AotCVD" /> carried by exterminators hired to control the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] population of [[Conduit worm/Legends|conduit worms]]. Functioning as a current reader,<ref name="FF97" /> it featured multimetric circuitry and a probe that detected currents weakened by conduit [[Worm/Legends|worms]]<ref name="AotCVD" /> and was used in conjungtion with an [[Ion stunner pistol|ion flare gun]] to locate and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the creatures.<ref name="FF97" />
